title: United Airlines blocks personal AI agents from booking flights
body_html:
United Airlines has announced it will not permit personal AI assistants to book tickets on its platform. The decision is driven by concerns regarding regulatory compliance and user privacy.

According to reports, the airline has not yet observed a high volume of customers attempting to use automated AI tools for travel reservations, a trend mirrored by other companies such as DoorDash. However, United is proactively establishing boundaries to address potential complications associated with unauthorized autonomous software interacting with its booking systems.
